latin: Illius naturae quae est orizon temporis et aeternitatis propria est magia, inde est petenda per modos debitos, notos sapientibus.
translation: That nature which forms the horizon of time and eternity has magic as its own; it is to be sought from it by the fitting means, known to the wise.
